title: Fallout 3 Costs You 19¢ an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Fallout 3 Game of the Year Edition is $4.99 on Steam until 30 Nov (75% off) and takes about 26 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat, main story): 19¢ an hour. Full price is 77¢ an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price, 25 Nov), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend who still talks about Megaton: Fallout 3 costs 19¢ an hour this week.
